what_it_does: Makes a temporary applet directory, pulls busybox again, then runs dx-docker add-to-applet once expecting a parse failure and once to bundle the busybox image into the applet resources.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: setUpClass already pulls busybox at line 68, nothing in the class removes it, and add-to-applet only runs docker save on the local image (local_image_to_aci in src/python/scripts/dx-docker), so the pull at line 130 repeats a registry manifest request for an image already on disk and changes no input or output. Removing the line is a local edit.

what_it_does: Creates a temporary project and folder, runs dx-docker create-asset on ubuntu:14.04 and busybox, and checks the names of the uploaded assets.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: setUpClass pulls ubuntu:14.04 at line 67, and create-asset reads only the local image through local_image_to_aci, so the pull at line 142 repeats a registry request for an image already on disk. If the setUpClass pull failed, the class would error before this test runs, so no failure path is lost.

what_it_does: After each test, deletes everything in the shared test project by looping over project_remove_folder until the server reports completion, then restores the environment variables.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The loop is the batched removal protocol that dxproject.py remove_folder (lines 183 to 210) and dx.py rm and rmdir also use, so each pass is server side deletion work rather than a poll, and a sleep would add only idle wall clock time. Dropping the per-test cleanup would let the 14 tests share state, which the test does not allow.

what_it_does: Writes 15 values into one JSON file, each through its own dx-jobutil-add-output process, then reads the file back and checks every key.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Each invocation is the production path, one name and value per process with its own argument parsing, exit code and flock guarded file update (src/python/scripts/dx-jobutil-add-output), and the script has no batch form. Merging the calls would need a different test or a change to the production script, which lies outside this unit.

what_it_does: Appends each of 15 values twice to arrays in one JSON file, each append through its own dx-jobutil-add-output process, then checks the resulting arrays.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The 30 invocations exercise the same production command per output, with its own argument parsing, exit code and flock guarded update, and the script has no batch form. Merging them would test a different program path or require changing the production script, which is outside this unit.

what_it_does: Runs dx-jobutil-new-job in test mode for one argument snippet and compares the printed input JSON with the expected hash.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The helper is the process boundary for each case in test_input and for the callers in test_job_arguments and test_extra_arguments (lines 963, 970, 977), and each case has its own argument list, name lookups and environment. Merging cases into one process would exercise a different path from the one each case states, and each process costs only one short Python start.

what_it_does: Runs the deepdirs test applet as a job, checks four output keys for their file counts, and checks that the files in six folders carry the expected names.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: list_folder with describe set to True returns each object's describe, which includes class and name, so the per-object get_handler and handler.name calls in verify_files_in_dir remove about 17 per-file describe requests while the six folder listings stay as they are. The class field replaces the isinstance check on DXFile, and the raised error and its text stay the same. This repair needs the DNAnexus API and is accepted on code merits.

what_it_does: Builds a fresh 512 MiB random payload for the mock file server on each POST, keeps it for range downloads, and records its md5 and size in the file description.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Measured in this session: joining the 1024 blocks once gives identical bytes and md5 for a fixed seed, but its median build time was 1.77 s against 1.49 s for the current BytesIO and getvalue build, over three runs each, so the copy removal does not save energy. A getbuffer variant would change the type of app.payload that serve_download slices, which lies outside this unit.

what_it_does: Returns the md5 hex digest of a local file by running the md5sum binary found on PATH and parsing its output.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: No file in the repository calls md5_checksum, since a grep for the name finds only its definition, so the md5sum fork it describes never runs and no saving exists. An in-process hash would also remove the md5sum-missing and failure exits that the function owns, which changes its behaviour.

what_it_does: Writes about 104 MB of random bytes to a local file, uploads it with a 100 MB write buffer to check the two part split, then downloads it and compares the copies.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: On Python 3 the unit cannot run, because the text mode read of urandom at line 86 raises UnicodeDecodeError (a 4 KB sample from the same interpreter failed the same way), and setUpClass writes a str to a binary temporary file at line 56. On Python 2 text and binary modes are identical, so there is no decode work to remove. The crash is a separate defect to report.

what_it_does: Runs dx build_asset --json on a dxasset.json directory, then checks the bundle's project and the instance type of the job that created it.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The same record is described twice in a row, and the second call reads only createdBy, which the first default describe already returned. Keeping the first result and indexing both fields from it removes one describe request and keeps the same assertions. This repair needs the DNAnexus API and is accepted on code merits.

what_it_does: Uploads a generated A.txt into a temporary project, builds the benchmark applet with the local bash helpers, and runs it with num_files references to that file.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The enclosing class is skipped at class level (line 561), so the unit never runs, and create_file_of_size at line 572 writes a str to a binary file, which fails on Python 3 before any upload. On the code merits, sharing one upload across tests needs state carried between temporary projects, which would change the isolation that temporary_project provides, and the applet run is the larger cost.

what_it_does: Runs one snippet in a fresh bash that sources the generated nextflow applet script with a stub dx on PATH, and returns stdout and the list of described IDs.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Each case needs a clean process for its environment (NXF_OFFLINE, run options, stub call log) and for set -e behaviour. One spawn that sources the template took a median of 6 ms over 20 runs here, so a persistent shell would add protocol code for a small saving. The decisive checks are the per-call environment block at lines 623 to 639 and the subprocess.run call at line 642.

what_it_does: Checks five quoted spellings of the -offline token, asserting the NXF_OFFLINE value and the rewritten run options for each.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The two calls run setup_offline_mode on identical inputs, so one bash run that prints the run options and NXF_OFFLINE, separated by a character that cannot occur in these values, gives both results. That removes five bash spawns and their stub calls per test run, and the assertions and expected values stay the same. The saving is a few tens of milliseconds.

what_it_does: For three cases, runs setup_offline_mode once to read the run options and once to read NXF_OFFLINE, and checks both values.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Both runs execute setup_offline_mode with the same describe output and environment, so one bash process that prints the run options and NXF_OFFLINE, separated by a character absent from these cases, gives both values. That removes one bash spawn and one set of dx stub calls per case, a saving of milliseconds per test run.

what_it_does: Checks that when the outbound internet query fails, NXF_OFFLINE stays unset and the run prints that it could not determine the state.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The two calls differ only in what they print, and setup_offline_mode writes the could not determine message to stdout, so one run that lets that message through and then echoes NXF_OFFLINE as the last line satisfies both assertions. That removes one bash spawn and one set of failing stub calls, a saving of milliseconds.

what_it_does: For each of the two manifest versions, parses the three referenced asset JSON files and checks that each maps `aws:us-east-1` to a record ID.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The loop reads six small files per run, a few microseconds of I/O and parsing each, which is too little to justify a cache. A module level cache would add shared state to a test that is meant to read the files as shipped.
